# Test fixtures

`pMCB306.gb` is the sequence of Addgene plasmid #89360 (pMCB306, a lentiviral sgRNA expression
vector cut with BstXI and BlpI; Han et al., Nat Biotechnol 2017, doi:10.1038/nbt.3834, depositor
Michael Bassik). It is used only to test two-enzyme cloning. The plasmid itself is distributed by
Addgene under an MTA; only the public sequence record is kept here.
